summary.source: Live S99 working tree, deterministic tie reproduction, first-run and feedback code paths, bounded task projection, current release authority, and current game-loop review.
summary.verificationNote: Both ranked premises were reproduced against live code. The repository-local studio-oracle and audit-premise executables are absent, so the typed premises are recorded for canonical verification and were manually checked with the named source patterns.

profile.rubric: first-user evidence, player-facing result truth, game-loop payoff, static-host safety, responsive accessibility, and release honesty
profile.staging: No deployment, launch flip, or public announcement is authorized by this audit.
profile.source: Fresh audit after the S99 Genius List and innovation pack both exhausted

feature-depth.candidate: post-game tie truth across recap, Franchise Moment, and press room
feature-depth.evidence: A deterministic 20-20 result renders Heartbreaker, Tough loss, two Loss headlines, and a one-score-loss press question.
Recent decisions still reserve the terminal ending for founder creative direction.

new-innovative-features.evidence: The game already records the first debrief and has local-only receipt primitives, but never joins them into an in-context invitation.
Useful after genuine cohort receipts exist; today it would optimize against self-selected local instrumentation.

ui-ux.evidence: The only detailed playtest controls are inserted at the top of Settings, away from the first completed decision loop.

ui-ux.candidate: collapse fourteen navigation targets into six
ui-ux.evidence: The rail is already grouped and mobile has a focused decision deck; a structural regroup requires a dedicated full visual baseline.

feedback-loop.candidate: connect the debrief checkpoint to the private receipt authority
feedback-loop.evidence: weekly-debrief-ready is recorded immediately after hydration, while receipt creation is only reachable manually from Settings.

feedback-loop.candidate: claim retention from Cloudflare page loads
feedback-loop.evidence: The project correctly states that aggregate page loads are not people, sessions, retention, or a cohort.

gamification-engagement.evidence: A tie receives loss audio/tone and loss narrative even though standings correctly render 2-2-1.

gamification-engagement.candidate: hidden mastery bonus for completing the pulse
gamification-engagement.evidence: A feedback action must not alter simulation outcomes or create coercive progression pressure.

ai-integration.candidate: deterministic outcome-state authority for narrative agents
ai-integration.evidence: Three narrative consumers independently collapse boolean not-win into loss; first-class win/loss/tie state removes that ambiguity without a provider.
Existing deterministic guidance is deep; provider inference adds cost and a data boundary without resolving the reproduced gaps.

security.evidence: Existing receipt code excludes identifiers and save payloads and sends nothing unless the player explicitly shares it.
External Obelisk is the declared identity architecture and no account flow is present.

speed-organization-efficiency.candidate: one outcome vocabulary across post-game consumers
speed-organization-efficiency.evidence: Boolean won is interpreted separately in rewardBeats, franchiseMomentHandler, pressConference, and pressRoom.
The first-run path already loads betaFeedback beside the tutorial; no new boot dependency is required.

token-api-reduction.candidate: reuse local receipt and modal primitives
token-api-reduction.evidence: The first-debrief pulse can remain browser-local and reuse current code with zero runtime API calls.
A vendor adds recurring cost and data access before a real cohort proves the local path insufficient.

items.category: Feature depth · feedback loop · gamification truth
items.title: Post-game reward, Franchise Moment, and press-room surfaces still turn a tie into a loss
items.executionEvidence: One shared game-result authority now carries win/loss/tie through recap, Franchise Moment, press headlines, interactive questions/effects, promises, and continuity. Exact 20-20 focused tests pass across reward, milestone, press-conference, and continuity suites; the final source-bound aggregate is green at 1,319/1,319 and Playwright is green at 55/55.
items.premise: S99 completed standings and career tie arithmetic, but the immediate emotional payoff still uses boolean won as a two-state outcome. A 20-20 game is called Heartbreaker, receives loss feedback, becomes a Tough loss and share-text Loss, and opens two Loss press stories plus a one-score-loss question.

premises.claim: week recap collapses every non-win to a loss headline
Franchise Moment persists only win or loss
press headlines collapse every non-win to Loss

items.fix: Make win/loss/tie a first-class result through recap, Franchise Moment, generated press copy, interactive questions, receipts, effects, and continuity. Add exact 20-20 tests and a sentinel that prevents post-game consumers from reintroducing two-state result copy.

L1.recipe: Correct recap, Franchise Moment, and press headlines/questions for a tie.

L2.recipe: Carry explicit result/isTie through press-room receipts and give tie responses neutral, disclosed consequences.

L3.recipe: L2 plus continuity semantics, focused browser/runtime tests, and a cross-consumer source sentinel.

items.title: The first completed decision loop records a debrief checkpoint but never invites the player to capture evidence there
items.executionEvidence: A one-time per-franchise, focus-safe first-debrief pulse now collects four explicit ratings plus an optional note, stores only a bounded local receipt, sends nothing automatically, and supports truthful copy/export feedback. Playwright is green at 55/55, four inspected desktop/mobile dark/light captures are permanently hash-ledgered, and lazy post-game loading leaves the first-decision graph at 643,495/650,000 bytes with zero lazy leaks.
items.premise: The game records weekly-debrief-ready at the exact first-loop payoff. The existing clarity, agency, pace, and return-intent receipt form is mounted only inside Settings, so an alpha tester can complete the signature loop without ever seeing the evidence control.

premises.claim: the app records the debrief-ready checkpoint
playtest controls are inserted into Settings
local receipt export explicitly disclaims cohort and causal claims
premises.pattern: cannot support cohort, retention, comprehension, or causal claims

items.fix: After the first successful weekly debrief per franchise, offer one skippable, focus-safe check-in that reuses the local-only receipt authority. Save nothing until explicit submission, send nothing automatically, permit copying the bounded receipt, and never show it again once answered or declined.

L1.recipe: Show a one-time local check-in link after the first debrief.

L2.recipe: Render the four existing ratings in a scoped, skippable dialog and store the existing receipt shape only on submit.

L3.recipe: L2 plus copy/export action, per-franchise answered/declined state, focus restoration, browser tests, and desktop/mobile dark/light rendered proof.

phantomsRejected.evidence: The game already has deep weekly, season, and dynasty loops; the missing evidence is real-player observation.
No account flows exist and Obelisk remains the only authorized future identity plane.
The reproduced onboarding gap is placement of an existing deterministic control, not missing inference.
Current aggregate telemetry and documentation explicitly refuse that conclusion.
The count is a credible risk but no real-user observation proves confusion; do not restructure it on assumption.
The working tree remains mutable and public launch authority remains false.
Local receipts plus explicit GitHub sharing cover the alpha need without cost or a new privacy boundary.

recommendedMoves: Finish tie truth at the emotional surfaces, not only standings and career arithmetic.
Ask for private evidence at the first debrief, where the player can still remember whether the loop was clear.
Keep the check-in local, explicit, skippable, per-franchise, and causally honest.
Keep public launch on HOLD until independent release authorities are verified.
